blogTitle: THE PLAYBILL (table 9 news, rehearsal notes, and feelings)
about: hi!! im hailey and im a Wildcat. (what team? WILDCATS!! see, u get it already.) also an Eagle (GO EAGLES, thats my actual school, i own the blue shirt) (u can be on 2 teams, i checked) (i didnt check). i have seen high school musical 14 times on the actual channel and 9 on the DVD (the sing-along one w the bouncing ball) and i own the soundtrack, the real CD, from target, and i have worn out the 2nd song. every day at 11:52 i run table 9 (by the vending machine, 13 members, 7 chairs + 1 stool + 1 recycling bin) and we do a routine. it has THE count: 5 6 7 8. (the best four numbers.) nobody has to audition. everybody gets a part. there are no extras at table 9, only ensemble, and the ensemble IS the show!!
aboutMore: things im NOT good at: basketball (i throw like im shooing a bee), singing on key if a piano is nearby (the piano knows), and being calm. things i AM good at: noticing who hasnt been asked to sit anywhere yet, talking mr pruitt (band director, also lunch duty) into one more run-thru, and 5 6 7 8. (ashley says theres a 1 2 3 4 before it. i believe her. i just havent met them.) i take jazz tues + thurs at dance dynamics, 3rd row far left, honestly the best spot, u see the whole room. my brother cole is 16, calls the routine 'the thing,' and was seen doing the basketball footwork in the driveway at 7 AM. i said nothing. hes going in as unnamed boy #4.
meet: Who I'd like to meet: troy and gabriella (i know theyre characters, i know the actors are different people, i know, i KNOW). whoever is writing the sequel (SEQUEL!!) so i can say i have a lunch table. a real choreographer, to ask how u fit 13 people into 4 counts. whoever picks the lunch menu, to ask for fewer sloppy joe days (the cymbals get sticky). and everybody who has ever eaten lunch alone, so i can say table 9. we have a stool.

interests.Music: the high school musical soundtrack (the real CD, from target, $12.99, i saved), the cheetah girls, hilary duff, kelly clarkson, the grease soundtrack (my moms CD, she says its HER CD), the karaoke tracks (im not proud of how many times), anything with a key change
interests.Movies: high school musical (14 on tv, 9 on DVD, plus 1 at a sleepover), the cheetah girls 2 (new this summer!!), grease (moms tape), the sound of music (grandma), newsies (the BOYS dance, its the best), annie (my audition song!! shh), mary poppins, bring it on (for the cheer parts), the lizzie mcguire movie (the ending)
interests.Television: disney channel (the whole channel), hannah montana (new!!), lizzie mcguire reruns, so you think you can dance (we vote on the house phone), dancing with the stars (mom lets me stay up), american idol (i yell 'be nice' at the tv)
interests.Books: the high school musical junior novel (its a book!!), dance spirit magazine (the library has it, im on the waitlist), the playbills from the 3 shows ive seen (in a binder w a ribbon), a book about stage fright my aunt gave me (read chapter 1 four times, thats the whole review)
interests.Heroes: troy and gabriella. zeke (he bakes things for people, nobody picks zeke, i pick zeke). kelsi (she writes the whole show and stands in the corner). my mom (drives me to jazz, owns a hot glue gun). ms delgado (jazz). mr pruitt (looks the other way, which is a kind of clapping). ashley (small AND brave, she said it, its laminated)

wall.text: [GREEN] Hailey. You came to open gym 4 minutes early. [RED] Standing order #2: if you're early you're on time. [BLUE] The count sheet is taped inside your locker (laminated). It starts at 1. Yes. 1. [PINK] You learned 1 2 3 4 in one afternoon and cried a little at the 4. That's allowed. It's in the legend.

Hailey. (He stands at the cafeteria doors, a tray held like a prop.) I watched thirteen people move as one body on a Tuesday. It has no count. It has no structure. It has, however, ensemble, which is the thing I have been trying to explain to a sophomore since the cast list. I am fine. I want that on the record. I am fine. -Thad

Hailey!! I took your halftime request to Mr. Pruitt. He said 'the band plays what the band plays,' then looked at the clarinets for 8 counts and said 'we'll see.' I am counting. 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8. Also, professional note: '5 6 7 8' is the second half of the count. There is a first half. I will teach it to you for a granola bar. -Becca, section leader

blog.title: WHY TABLE 9 EXISTS (the true story) (its a long one)
blog.body: everybody asks how it started. heres the true story. in 7th grade my best friend kennedy moved to arizona in june. we had a pact, we sat at the same table every day since 3rd grade. in september i walked into the cafeteria and there was no table. like, there was a table, but it wasnt OURS. so i ate by the vending machine, alone, for 2 months. it was fine. (it was not fine.) to get through it i started counting in my head. 5 6 7 8, over and over, like right before a dance. then my hands started doing it. then my feet. then one day a girl named talia sat down across from me and said 'what are you doing' and i said 'rehearsing' and she said 'for what' and i said 'i dont know yet.' she did the milk carton on count 6. thats the first routine. now were 13. nobody eats alone at table 9. theres a stool. its for whoever shows up next. its always been for whoever shows up next.

blog.title: AUDITION REPORT part 1: the clipboard (i have to think about the clipboard)
blog.body: the audition is next friday. its in the auditorium w a table and a clipboard and ms marchetti, who says 'again, with feeling' like a spell. i have thought about the clipboard for 4 days. things i have learned: 1) she banned high school musical songs (11 last year, one boy brought a basketball) so im doing 16 bars of 'tomorrow' from annie. 2) thad says be big in the first 2 bars, they decide fast. 3) cole says dont throw up. 4) my dad says pretend the panel is the lunch ladies. i tried that. the lunch ladies clap, so thats unfair to the panel. 5) at lunch today the whole table did my 16 bars with me, quietly, just the counts, and it was SO loud in my head. i dont need to be a lead. i dont even need a line. i just want to be IN it. townspeople are the show. ill report back. if i dont post, i went to the bathroom to breathe. 5 6 7 8.
